hot_path.name: RunResidentRows
hot_path.source_reads: x and residual are consumed once per row
hot_path.resident_value: FP32 u=x+residual remains in one UB row
hot_path.precision: FP32 u/rms cast to native (O(1)), then *gamma+bias in FP32, one cast at output

generic_path.name: RunGenericRows
generic_path.coverage: FP16/BF16/FP32 and all legal rows and D
generic_path.precision: same NormNative chain as hot path

v007_changes.baseline: V002 arithmetic restored exactly (no u-quantize, no invRms, no bias-after-cast, V002 gamma order)
v007_changes.single_change: intermediate cast of u/rms (O(1)) to native before *gamma: T(T(u/rms)*gamma+bias) was T(u/rms*gamma+bias)
v007_changes.rationale: isolated A/B of normalized-value quantize; O(1) magnitude cannot overflow large-D cases

submission.integration: G001 Child V007: V002 baseline + u/rms intermediate cast single change
